title: Straightforward feasible launch
explanation: The schedule is feasible: QA can complete on or after 2026-09-23, which is at least five days after the 2026-09-18 code freeze and still before the 2026-09-25 launch deadline.

title: Challenge: green project but impossible QA window
explanation: Code freeze is committed for 2026-09-25. QA cannot finish earlier than 7 days later, i.e. before 2026-10-02, and must finish before launch. Therefore launch must occur after 2026-10-02, which contradicts the requirement that it launch no later than 2026-09-30.
repair: Move the code freeze to 2026-09-23 or earlier, or move the launch deadline to 2026-10-03 or later.

title: Dependency lands after launch
explanation: Launch must occur no later than 2026-10-10, but it may occur only after vendor migration completes on 2026-10-11. Therefore, the launch cannot satisfy both requirements.
repair: Move the launch deadline to 2026-10-11 or later, or complete the vendor migration by 2026-10-10.

title: Security approval timing conflict
explanation: Release must occur by 2026-10-15, but security approval is not complete until the scheduled security review finishes on 2026-10-16. Since completing that review constitutes approval and approval must be complete by release, the commitments conflict.
repair: Complete the security review by 2026-10-15 or earlier, or move the release deadline to 2026-10-16 or later.

title: Feasible chained delivery
explanation: The database migration completes on 2026-11-02, and API validation can complete at least two days later, on or after 2026-11-04. The launch deadline of 2026-11-08 occurs after API validation, so the commitments are feasible.

title: Two-stage testing chain impossible
explanation: Feature completion is fixed for 2026-11-20. Integration testing cannot complete before 2026-11-24, and regression cannot complete before 2026-11-28. Therefore the required regression completion cannot meet the 2026-11-26 launch deadline.
repair: Move the launch deadline to 2026-11-28 or later, or move feature completion earlier so both minimum testing intervals fit before 2026-11-26.

title: Enough buffer after legal approval
explanation: Legal approval completes on 2026-12-01, and release may occur on or after that date. The 2026-12-05 deadline allows a feasible release date between 2026-12-01 and 2026-12-05.

title: Earliest marketing launch conflicts with executive deadline
explanation: Campaign assets cannot be ready before 2026-12-12 (MKT1), and launch cannot occur before assets are ready (P1). Therefore launch cannot occur before 2026-12-12, contradicting the commitment to launch no later than 2026-12-10 (CEO1).
repair: Move the launch deadline to 2026-12-12 or later, or make campaign assets ready by 2026-12-10.

title: Feasible approval and launch
explanation: Business sign-off completes on 2026-09-07, and launch is only required not to precede sign-off. A launch by the 2026-09-10 deadline is therefore feasible.

title: Cutover rehearsal too late
explanation: The cutover rehearsal is fixed for 2026-09-18, and production launch can occur only after it. Therefore, launch cannot occur before 2026-09-18, conflicting with the 2026-09-17 launch deadline.
repair: Move the production launch deadline to 2026-09-19 or later, or reschedule the cutover rehearsal before 2026-09-17.

title: Feasible post-freeze QA
explanation: The commitments are mutually feasible: with code freeze on 2026-10-01, QA can complete on or after 2026-10-04 and still be completed by the 2026-10-07 launch deadline.

title: Long hidden dependency chain
explanation: Migration finishes on 2026-10-20. Reconciliation requires at least 3 days afterward, and business validation requires at least 2 more days, so validation cannot be complete before 2026-10-25. Since launch requires completed validation, the 2026-10-24 launch deadline is impossible.
repair: Move the launch deadline to 2026-10-25 or later, or reduce the required post-migration/reconciliation durations.
